output.reason: At 32 weeks pregnant with persistent headache, blurred vision and facial/hand swelling, possible severe preeclampsia requires immediate emergency obstetric assessment with blood pressure and lab testing today.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now — ideally your hospital's labor and delivery unit. A persistent headache, blurry vision and puffy face and hands at 32 weeks can mean preeclampsia, which needs blood pressure and blood/urine testing right away. Have someone drive you; do not drive yourself. If you have a seizure, severe belly pain, or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately.
differential: Preeclampsia with severe features at 32 weeks
Other pregnancy-related cause of new headache (e.g. cerebral venous thrombosis, PRES)
